regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, defensive-led regime: Big Pharma is the headline eligible leader (rank 2, durability 0.84, confirming hedonic state, crowded at 1.46), Health Care EW, Defensives and Consumer Staples follow, while AI/semis leadership (Memory & Storage is rank-1 but INELIGIBLE with durability 0.35) has rolled over into a mean-revert/mixed tape. The rotation signal is non-directional and narrowing (eligible 19/49), so no handoff is confirmed; the only validated edge is the trend gate (gate_helps true), which supports sticking with eligible, high-durability defensives and de-risking the rest of the book.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the current eligible defensive leadership (Big Pharma/Health Care/Staples) begins to lose its trend gate: confirm a fade in leadership (not a prediction) only if XLV and XLP both see breadth drop below 0.5 and durability_bar fall below 0.6 while another eligible theme simultaneously crosses eligible with breadth above 0.8. Retire the watch if the defensive bloc holds durability above 0.7 through the next rotation print.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the strongest ELIGIBLE theme with a trend tag, near-unity breadth, and confirming hedonic state. The trend gate is the one validated edge in this market; when it is bright green on a defensive healthcare leader while AI/semis leadership has gone ineligible, the trade-able bias is to remain with the confirmed, durable, eligible leadership rather than the ranked-but-ineligible Memory & Storage theme.
evidence: eligible=true and durability_bar=0.84 (highest among eligible top themes)
theses.dissent: Crowding_z=1.46 and crowded=true means any further strength may be limited on a forward basis; crowdedness has no forward return edge, so this leans only on the already-realized trend and durability, not on a reason for new acceleration.

falsifier.text: PPH closes below its 50-day moving average for 5 consecutive sessions before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Adjacent to Big Pharma, the equal-weight health care sector is eligible, durable, and trending with high breadth. It provides exposure to the same defensive leadership area without relying solely on pharma names, consistent with staying with the confirmed eligible defensive bloc.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z=1.54 (crowded=true) is extreme; a crowded defensive leadership area can stall via mean-reversion even if trend is intact.

falsifier.text: XLV closes below its 20-day moving average for 5 consecutive sessions before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples EW is eligible, durable (0.8), and trending with broad participation. It is part of the broader defensive leadership pocket that the trend gate currently blesses, reinforcing the same defensive tilt rather than a new signal.
evidence: crowding_z=1.89 (most crowded among defensives — sizing caution, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Crowding at 1.89 is the highest in the defensive bloc; the space may be at peak attention, which is a reason to keep conviction low and avoid adding aggressively.

falsifier.text: XLP lags the S&P 500 by more than 3% before the 20-day check-by date
